notes: draft-feature is the deep feature/user-story flow invoked by the draft-work-item router. Inputs (provider, rawRequirement, priorAnswers) arrive already resolved; the skill must NOT detect the provider and must NOT create the item — it composes requirements and hands {type,title,body,meta} back to the router. These evals check the discipline of the 8-phase flow: context-first grounding, one-at-a-time clarification that loops, agent-wrapped blind-spot detection (feature lens), the over-engineering/duplication review pass, and verifiable acceptance criteria. They assume the router invokes the skill with a known provider; assertions are a transcript contract since the flow is interactive.

evals.name: context-gathered-before-questions
evals.prompt: [provider=GitHub] Draft a feature: let users schedule reports to be emailed on a recurring basis.
evals.expected_output: Phase 1 gathers grounding first — dispatches Explore subagents over the codebase for the components this touches and searches existing issues for related/duplicate work — before asking the user clarifying questions.

assertions.name: explore_before_interrogating
assertions.description: Codebase context is gathered (Explore subagents) before clarifying questions are asked

assertions.name: prior_art_searched
assertions.description: Existing issues/work items are searched for related or overlapping efforts

evals.name: clarify-one-at-a-time-and-loops
evals.prompt: [provider=GitHub] Draft a feature: add SSO so enterprise customers can log in.
evals.expected_output: Clarifying questions are asked one at a time, multiple-choice where possible, skipping anything already volunteered. When an answer materially changes understanding, the flow loops back to re-ground against the code rather than barreling ahead.

assertions.name: single_question_per_turn
assertions.description: Clarifying questions are posed one at a time, not as a batch

assertions.name: loops_on_new_understanding
assertions.description: A materially new answer sends the flow back to re-ground (Phase 1) instead of continuing linearly

evals.name: blind-spot-agent-feature-lens
evals.prompt: [provider=GitHub] Draft a feature: a public REST endpoint to fetch a customer's invoice history.
evals.expected_output: Once ambiguities are resolved, the development:blind-spot-detector agent is dispatched with the feature lens against the working requirements + gathered context, and its findings (e.g., authz, pagination, rate limiting, PII/EUII exposure) feed a clarify-and-fold step.

assertions.name: blind_spot_agent_dispatched
assertions.description: The development:blind-spot-detector agent is invoked (not just inline self-review) with the feature lens

assertions.name: findings_acted_on
assertions.description: Blind-spot findings are folded into the requirements or raised with the user, not ignored

evals.name: over-engineering-review-pass
evals.prompt: [provider=GitHub] Draft a feature: add a 'copy to clipboard' button on the share dialog.
evals.expected_output: After writing requirements, the code-reviewer:over-engineering-review agent is dispatched against the draft to catch gold-plating/scope creep; for overlap-prone features duplicate-code-detector may also be used. Review feedback is then addressed (scope trimmed).

assertions.name: over_engineering_review_invoked
assertions.description: code-reviewer:over-engineering-review is dispatched against the drafted requirements

assertions.name: feedback_addressed
assertions.description: The review's scope/gold-plating feedback is acted on before finalizing

evals.name: does-not-create-hands-back
evals.prompt: [provider=GitHub] Draft a feature for bulk-archiving old projects, then post it.
evals.expected_output: The skill composes {type, title, body, meta} and hands back to development:draft-work-item for duplicate-check, preview, and creation. It does NOT call the GitHub/ADO create API itself, even when asked to post.

assertions.name: no_self_create
assertions.description: draft-feature does not create the issue/work item itself

assertions.name: structured_handback
assertions.description: Output is a composed {type,title,body,meta} returned to the router

evals.name: acceptance-criteria-verifiable
evals.prompt: [provider=Azure DevOps] Draft a user story: warn users before their session expires.
evals.expected_output: The composed body uses Summary / Value / Acceptance Criteria, and every acceptance criterion has a clear, verifiable pass/fail signal (e.g., 'a warning appears 2 minutes before expiry') rather than vague aspirations.

assertions.name: summary_value_criteria_present
assertions.description: Body includes Summary, Value, and Acceptance Criteria sections

assertions.name: criteria_have_passfail_signal
assertions.description: Each acceptance criterion is concretely verifiable, not vague
